LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_OhoCelestialRobe.label: (Raven) Oho Celestial Robe
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_OhoCelestialRobe.descripti: Legend says that in ancient times, a special kind of fairy existed outside heavenly law, dancing alone deep in the mountains. When moonlight pierced the clouds and fell upon them, they would emit a long, hypnotic hum known to mortals as "Oho". This garment was modeled after the forms of those fairies. Made of light gauze with a flowing cut, it appears to be a cold, unapproachable fairy dress, yet hides secrets in its details: a slightly open neckline, a faintly visible waistline, and sheer silk scarves that casually slip down with movement. The wearer seems ready to enter a state of total ecstasy at any moment. As the poem goes: "Cloud garments half-undone reveal intent, immortal sounds enter the soul. If not a true fairy, who would dare wear this dress?"
